Engineers embedded with your team

Evaluate

Simulation + Improvement: catch failures before your customers do.

Every agent runs through thousands of real-world scenarios before going live. Once live, it monitors itself and improves automatically, no manual intervention.

Production logs feed back automatically. Agents get sharper with every run, without you managing it.

Everything you build lives in your environment, on open protocols, under your control. If you ever move, it all moves with you. No exit penalty.

Why Enterprises Choose Lyzr

Five reasons developers
pick Lyzr.

Orchestrate

SuperFlow: any framework, one execution canvas.

Wire LangChain, CrewAI, Agentforce, and Lyzr-native agents into a single durable execution canvas, with loops, gates, conditionals, and human-in-the-loop, all with exactly-once execution.

Any framework as a first-class node

LangChain, CrewAI, Agentforce, all orchestrated in one canvas via native MCP. No wrapper glue.

Durable execution, exactly-once steps

No silent failures. No partial runs. Every step completes exactly once or rolls back cleanly.

Modify flows mid-conversation

Add a branch, change a gate, update a step through a prompt, without touching agent logic.

Any stack One canvas. One runtime. One source of truth for your entire workflow.
Deploy

GitAgent & CI/CD: ship agents like real software.

Agent definitions are versioned artifacts. Full Git lineage, a structured pipeline, and one-command rollback, across any framework you're using.

Git-native across any framework

Branching, PRs, commit history, one-command rollback. Every agent has full lineage from day one.

Structured pipeline with real gates

Build, Simulate, Review, Approve, Deploy. Security, compliance, and LOB approvals built into the pipeline.

Instant rollback per release

Every deployment is versioned. What you tested in staging is exactly what runs in production.

Versioned Every release. Instant rollback. Full audit trail. No bespoke glue.
Evaluate

Simulation + Improvement: failures caught before production.

Run thousands of synthetic scenarios before deployment. Once live, every run is traced, scored, and fed back automatically. Drift caught. Edge cases become the next test suite.

Pre-production simulation at scale

1,000s of scenario runs, adversarial, edge case, domain-specific, before your agent touches traffic.

Regression on every commit

Same simulations re-run when models upgrade or prompts change. Catch regressions before they ship.

Closed-loop improvement

OTel traces, drift detection, automated reinforcement, CI/CD promotion. No manual intervention.

85% production ship rate. Industry average is under 30%. This is how.
Optimize

ShadowLM: frontier-model output, smaller-model cost.

Distill the behavior of GPT-4o, Claude, and Gemini into smaller, faster models tuned to your specific use cases, continuously validated by simulation so quality is tracked, not assumed.

Distill top-tier model behavior

Shadow the best models and replicate their output in smaller models built for your exact use case.

Quality tracked by simulation

Every distilled model is validated by the Simulation Engine. You ship with a confidence score, not a guess.

Works across your full model stack

GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or your own fine-tuned models. ShadowLM adapts to your stack.

Lower TCO Same output quality. Proven on every run by the Simulation Engine.
Govern

Control Plane: every agent visible, one policy everywhere.

One ingress. One canonical inventory. One policy engine evaluated at runtime, across Lyzr-native, LangChain, Agentforce, Databricks, ServiceNow, and custom agents.

Single ingress for all agent traffic

Rate limiting, policy enforcement, and observability applied uniformly, regardless of which vendor built the agent.

Registry of every agent in production

Ownership, lineage, version history, risk posture, one source of truth, always current.

Runtime entitlement beyond your IdP

Per-customer caps, per-region restrictions, time-based rules, evaluated at runtime against your identity provider.

One policy engine. Every agent, regardless of where it was built or where it runs.
Works with what you've built

Your stack stays. Lyzr connects.

Whatever your team already runs, LangChain, CrewAI, Agentforce, custom, it stays where it is. Lyzr's control plane sits above it all, adding governance, observability, and policy without forcing a migration.

Bring your existing LangChain chains as first-class nodes. No rewrites.
